title: Marienfelder Allee, Berlin
description:
Excellent one-bedroom apartment, fully furnished and located in a pleasant residential area of Berlin.
The apartment is situated on the second floor of the building (no elevator). One on-site parking space with gated access is available for tenants and included in the rental price.
The spacious 25 sqm living/sleeping area features a double bed (convertible into two single beds upon request), a large wardrobe, a dedicated workspace with desk and chair, a two-seater sofa, TV, and a bookshelf. A comfortable and livable balcony with table and chairs is accessible directly from the living area.
The kitchen includes a dining table with two chairs, fridge, gas oven and stove, microwave, coffee maker, and complete sets of cookware and tableware. No dishwasher is available.
For additional comfort, the apartment is equipped with a safe box, vacuum cleaner, iron, and unlimited Wi-Fi internet.
The bathroom, with a large window, includes a shower/bathtub, washing machine, and all essential fittings.
A furnished entrance hallway provides a welcoming atmosphere and generous storage space.
The apartment is located along the B101, offering easy access to major highways.
Public transport connections are excellent: a bus stop is just 20 meters from the building, and the S-Bahn station Marienfelde (S2 line) is approximately 500 meters away.
Several supermarkets, shops, and restaurants are within walking distance.

title: Kulmbacher Straße, Berlin
description:
Beautiful, cozy apartment in Berlin, Schönberg, just a 3-minute walk from KaDeWe and Kurfürstendamm. This means that the apartment is close to many nice cafes and restaurants, some of which serve very good international cuisine. In this hotspot location, all kinds of shops are of course nearby. This also includes many well-known chain stores such as Peek and Cloppenburg. 

Fortunately, the apartment is in a beautiful building in a quieter area, so you don't have to worry about the noise of the high streets. Public transport is of course very close to the apartment and supermarkets are just around the corner. 

According to a recent analysis by HousingAnywhere, the apartment is below average in price, but is in a far above-average location in Berlin. 

The apartment has a bed and a sofa that can be converted into a double bed. The living room leads to a beautiful private balcony where you can work or eat while looking out onto the quiet alley. Unlike most apartments in Berlin, the kitchen is in its own room with plenty of seating. This allows couples to cook/sit in peace without disturbing the other person.

title: Münchener Straße, Berlin
description:
Vollausgestattetes Apartment im Hochpaterre eines Berliner Altbaus in der Nähe des Viktoria-Luise-Platzes im Bayerischen Viertel, 10 Minuten Fußweg zum Ku ́Damm. Mit großer Liebe zum Detail wohnen Sie in einer komplett umgebauten Wohnung  auf 38qm.

In der Ausführung wurde besonderer Wert auf die Verwendung ökologischer Materialien sowie Nachhaltigkeit gelegt. Ein massgeschneiderte Küche sowie Designmöbel von Vitra und USM runden das Wohngefühl ab.
Ursprüngliches Fischgratparkett sowie Dielen liegen in Küche, Flur und Schlafzimmer. Das Bad ist mit Naturstein augestattet. Grosse Fensterfronten mit Rolläden und Vorhängen sorgen  für ein helles Raumerlebnis.

Das Apartment mit einer Raumhöhe von 3,40 m bietet Ihnen anspruchsvolle Einbauten mit viel Stauraum und mit einer sehr hochwertigen Ausstattung für Kochen, Schlafen, Entspannen und Arbeiten. Badezimmereinrichtung, Möbel, Beleuchtung und Accessoires sind sorgfältig ausgesucht. Die Küche bietet Ihnen ein Cerankochfeld, Spülmaschine, Kühlschrank und einen Backofen  von Miele. Sie schlafen auf einem 140 cm breiten biologischen Lattenrost, einer Naturlatex Matratze in biologischen Baumwollbettbezügen. 

Sie erwartet ein Entertain TV, VDSL Internet und W LAN. Küchengeräte, Wasserkocher, Toaster, Waschmaschine (Miele), Bügeleisen und vieles mehr sind inklusive. Der Mietpreis versteht sich inklusive aller Nebenkosten und inklusive einer 2 wöchentlichen  Reinigung. Die Endreinigung wird zusätzlich in Rechnung gestellt.

Das Apartment befindet sich in einem lebendigen, nicht touristischen, gemischten Wohngebiet zwischen dem Prager-, dem Bayerischen- und dem Viktoria-Luise-Platz. Als Vermieter wohnen wir mit unserer Familie in dem gleichen Gebäude im 1.OG und sind schnell ansprechbar.

Der Viktoria-Luise-Platz in Schöneberg zählt zu den schönsten Plätzen Berlins. In unmittelbarer Umgebung befinden sich zahlreiche sehr gute Restaurants. Der Bayerische Platz bietet sehr gute Einkaufsmöglichkeiten von Drogerien bis hin zu Bio-Supermärkten, ein großes Fittnessstudio und zahlreiche weitere Geschäfte und Cafés. Fußläufig erreichen Sie das KadeWe, den Kurfürstendamm und die City West. Der bekannte Winterfeldplatz mit vielen kleinen Geschäften und dem ganzjährigen Wochenmarkt am Mittwoch und Samstag befindet sich nur 1 Kilometer entfernt. 

Das Apartment liegt an der U Bahnlinie 4 mit Anbindung an die U Bahnlinien U1, U2 und U3 (Nollendorfplatz) sowie die U 7 am Bayerischen Platz. Die S Bahnlinien erreichen Sie über die U 4 am Innsbrucker Platz. Stellplätze sind in der Regel im Strassenraum vorhanden. Der Bahnhof Südkreuz, die Stadtautobahn und der Flughafen Tegel sind von Schöneberg sehr gut erreichbar.

The Neighbourhood

The apartment is located in a lively, non-touristy, mixed residential area between Pragerplatz, Bayerischenplatz and Viktoria-Luise-Platz. As landlords, we live with our family in the same building on the 1st floor and can be contacted quickly.

Viktoria-Luise-Platz in Schöneberg is one of the most beautiful squares in Berlin. There are numerous very good restaurants in the immediate vicinity. Bayerischer Platz offers very good shopping opportunities from drugstores to organic supermarkets, a large fitness studio and numerous other shops and cafés. Within walking distance you can reach the KadeWe, the Kurfürstendamm and the City West. The well-known Winterfeldplatz with many small shops and the year-round weekly market on Wednesdays and Saturdays is only 1 kilometer away.

The apartment is located on subway line 4 with connections to subway lines U1, U2 and U3 (Nollendorfplatz) as well as U7 at Bayerischer Platz. You can reach the S-Bahn lines via the U 4 at Innsbrucker Platz. Parking spaces are usually available on the street. The Südkreuz train station, the city motorway and Tegel Airport are easily accessible from Schöneberg.

About This Property

Fully equipped apartment on the mezzanine floor of an old Berlin building near Viktoria-Luise-Platz in the Bavarian Quarter, 10 minutes walk to Ku'Damm. With great attention to detail, you live in a completely renovated apartment on 38 square meters.

In the execution, particular emphasis was placed on the use of ecological materials and sustainability. A tailor-made kitchen and designer furniture from Vitra and USM round off the living experience.
Original herringbone parquet and floorboards are in the kitchen, hallway and bedroom. The bathroom is equipped with natural stone. Large window fronts with shutters and curtains ensure a bright room experience.

The apartment with a ceiling height of 3.40 m offers you sophisticated fittings with plenty of storage space and very high-quality equipment for cooking, sleeping, relaxing and working. Bathroom furnishings, furniture, lighting and accessories are carefully selected. The kitchen has a ceramic hob, dishwasher, refrigerator and a Miele oven. You sleep on a 140 cm wide organic slatted frame, a natural latex mattress in organic cotton bed covers.

You can expect an Entertain TV, VDSL Internet and WiFi. Kitchen appliances, kettle, toaster, washing machine (Miele), iron and much more are included. The rental price includes all additional costs and includes cleaning twice a week. The final cleaning will be charged additionally.

title: Yorckstraße, Berlin
description:
Modern, newly renovated, and fully furnished studio apartment, centrally located in colorful Berlin Kreuzberg. Just a few minutes walk from two big parks and buzzing Bergmann Kiez, this lovely studio apartment is tucked away in the quiet side wing of a typical early 20th century Berlin Townhouse. It combines cozy wooden floors with a modern, minimalist interior and furnishings, and a bright, spacious living room and balcony. The apartment comes equipped with everything you need to just arrive and feel right at home:

- Unlimited 100 MBit Wifi 
- Fully equipped Kitchen with induction cooking
- Spacious walk-in wardrobe
- Balcony with lounge furniture
- Elevator access
- Fridge/freezer
- Microwave 
- Nespresso Machine 
- Dining table & chairs 
- Double Bed 
- Fold-out couch 
- Spacious wardrobe 
- 32" Cable Smart LCD TV
 - Iron & Board 
- Vacuum cleaner & cleaning utensils 
- Washing machine 
- Spacious, bright bathroom with large walk-in shower 
- Hairdryer 
- Linen, towels & sheets  
- Smoke alarm
- Door intercom system

- Cafes & Shops

No smoking or pets.

title: Gneisenaustraße, Berlin
description:
I am temporarily subletting my Berlin flat, as I will be living in London.

The flat is 56m2 and perfect for a couple (you can have it just for yourself as well of course). There's one bedroom and a larger room which combines the kitchen and living area. It has a nice parquet floor and is bright.
It's right next to the U7 stop, around the corner from Bergmannstr. and the Marheineke covered market. It's in the inner courtyard, very quiet, 4th floor.

The flat is fully functional, you'll be able to use all of the furniture that you see on the pictures. Whatever isn't to your taste could also go in the attic.
There is a washing machine and dryer as well as a dishwasher, oven and microwave.
I have reliable 50 Mps internet and you can use my desk setup with the screen. There is also a projector and bluetooth speakers in the living room.
You are also welcome to use my bike during your stay.

Gemütlicher Wohnbereich (voll möbliert & bezugsfertig)

Eigene private Terrasse mit direktem Blick in den ruhigen, grünen Garten

title: Derfflingerstraße, Berlin
description:
Helle, frisch sanierte Wohnung in Berlin-Lichterfelde Ost,

Zur Vermietung steht eine wunderschöne, frisch kernsanierte Wohnung in ruhiger und sicherer Lage von Berlin-Lichterfelde Ost. Die Wohnung wird zunächst für ein Jahr vermietet.
Sie verfügt über ein großes Schlafzimmer sowie einen großzügigen Wohn- und Essbereich mit offener Küche. Dank der großen Fenster ist die Wohnung außergewöhnlich hell und lichtdurchflutet und bietet den ganzen Tag eine angenehme Wohnatmosphäre.
Die moderne Einbauküche ist vollständig ausgestattet und verfügt unter anderem über einen Geschirrspüler, einen Kühlschrank mit Gefrierfach sowie weitere hochwertige Elektrogeräte.
Ein besonderes Highlight ist der schöne Balkon, der zum Entspannen einlädt und den Wohnkomfort zusätzlich erhöht.
Die Verkehrsanbindung ist hervorragend: Die S-Bahn-Linien S25 und S26 sind schnell erreichbar, zudem befinden sich zahlreiche Busverbindungen in unmittelbarer Nähe. Durch die Regionalbahn gelangen Sie in nur etwa 20 Minuten zum Berliner Hauptbahnhof.
Die Umgebung zeichnet sich durch ihre Ruhe, Sicherheit und hohe Lebensqualität aus. Einkaufsmöglichkeiten, Grünflächen und alle Einrichtungen des täglichen Bedarfs sind bequem erreichbar.
Eine ideale Wohnung für alle, die helles, komfortables Wohnen in einer angenehmen und gut angebundenen Lage schätzen. :::

title: Wexstraße, Berlin
description:
ParkSuites Wilmersdorf–Furnished apartment in a modern building next to Volkspark, 7-minute walk from the train station.

Your new home is located in a modern new building with high-quality amenities in the Charlottenburg-Wilmersdorf district. Floor-to-ceiling windows, real wood parquet flooring, smooth plastered walls, and much more await you. A panoramic view of the quiet courtyard is included.
The apartment is furnished and features a kitchenette with a ceramic hob, microwave, refrigerator, and sink. The bathroom with a shower features a hand basin, a wall-mounted toilet, and a mirror. Ceiling lighting is also provided.
 
 
7-minute walk from the subway station, all operating costs are included in the rent price (except electricity), official registration (Anmeldung), private fully equipped kitchen and bathroom with a shower, high-speed Internet, bedsheets, the size of the bed is 90x200, separated laundry room with washing machines and dryers.
 
A special feature is the underfloor heating, which provides a pleasant warmth and gives a cozy feeling. The building itself is equipped with an elevator.
 
Amenities & Furniture: Fitted kitchen, Elevator, New Construction, Floor heating, Energy Certificate, Working desk, Chairs, Wardrobe, Cutlery, Pans & kitchen accessories, Refrigerator, Microwave, Single bed (90x200), Laundry room, Shower, Wardrobe, Mirror.

Position
Sought-after location in Wilmersdorf
The Charlottenburg-Wilmersdorf district is a traditionally highly sought-after location in western Berlin. Living between Kurfürstendamm and Schloßstraße is highly sought-after: S-Bahn and U-Bahn in the immediate vicinity, Volkspark Wilmersdorf on your doorstep, and a diverse range of local amenities – all the features of a prime urban location come together here.
 
The Innsbrucker Platz U-Bahn and S-Bahn station, serving lines S41 and S42 (Ringbahn) and U4, is approximately 500 meters away or a 7 minute walk.
 
The Bundesplatz U-Bahn and S-Bahn station, serving lines U9 and S41 and S42, is approximately 600 meters away or a 9 minutes walk.
 
Buses 187, 248, M48, and M85 also stop at Innsbrucker Platz.
 
Supermarket ALDI Nord is 150 meters away or a 2 minute walk. 

Travel times by public transport:

Free University of Berlin: 25 minutes
Technical University of Berlin: 30 minutes
Humboldt University: 35 minutes
The local amenities are equally positive: various shops are within walking distance on Wexstraße and Bundesallee.

Information on equipment
Amenities
** Real wood parquet
** Pantry kitchen with sink, ceramic stove, fridge
, and microwave
** Furniture (without guarantee): Wardrobe, shelf, bed including mattress, desk, desk chair, high table with chairs,
curtains, ceiling lights
** Passenger elevator
** Bicycle cellar/locker room for bikes
** Laundry room with washing machine and dryers (use at your own expense)
The amenities
All apartments have high-quality parquet flooring, a comfortable bed, and a spacious wardrobe. In the ParkSuites, the day starts with a refreshing shower in the modern bathroom and ends in the functional kitchen, whose sophisticated equipment invites you to cook and enjoy delicious meals.
The modern kitchenette
The unit in the ParkSuites already includes a high-quality kitchenette – with versatile storage space for a single household and various electrical appliances.
Cooking, reheating, and cooling: From a fully integrated undercounter refrigerator to a glass ceramic cooktop with a flat-panel hood and a built-in microwave, the unit includes all the appliances you need for everyday use. Its elegant design and compact size make it a perfect fit for any floor plan.
The elegant bathroom features plumbing in brilliant white, large-format tiles in muted colors, and a sleek shower cubicle with a real glass shower screen – this combination makes it child's play to visually enlarge even a small bathroom and transform it into a pleasant oasis of well-being. Each shower room in the ParkSuites is equipped with the highest standards of quality and comfort. Only furnishings from renowned brand manufacturers are used – from the vanity to the shower set.

title: Kurfürstenstraße, Berlin
description:
This fully furnished 21 sqm-room is one out of 2 in the newly renovated apartment in Berlin-Tempelhof and is a perfect place to kickstart your Berlin experience. Either alone or with your partner as the rooms are very spacious and have 180cm x 200cm beds. The flat itself is 82 sqm in total and features 2 shared rooms (co-livings-rooms), a bath room, a balcony, a washing room an aisle with an extra wardrobe to store your storage as well as a spacious kitchen fully equipped with:

- DeLonghi portafilter coffee machine
- Dishwasher
- Washing machine
- Mixer, Boiler, and all tools you need for cooking

The kitchen also includes a beautiful wooden dining table as well as 4 chairs and access to the balcony.

Each room has a bed, desk, chest of drawers and clothes rail as well as pictures frames / carpets and can be individually decorated by you. 

Rent, high-quality furniture, electricity, heating, Internet, all utilities, 2 sets of bed linen and towels, and regular cleaning service.

Area and connectivity: 

The U6 and S2 will bring you to Berlin central within 15 minutes. Both stations are only a 10 - 15 minutes stroll or a 5 minutes bus-ride away. 

The area offers quiet and green surroundings like a Volkspark Mariendorf and the waterfront at Teltow-Kanal. Tempelhof offers a peaceful retreat from the hustle of Berlin’s city center. You’ll love the nearby parks and green spaces, like Tempelhofer Feld, ideal for jogging, picnics, or simply unwinding.

title: Obentrautstraße, Berlin
description:
This bright and modern 75 sqm apartment is located on the 6th floor of a well-maintained building in Kreuzberg, easily accessible by elevator. It features a smart two-room layout with a separate bedroom and a private balcony, offering a comfortable and airy living environment in a central location.

Situated in a vibrant and central part of Berlin, the area offers a great mix of urban convenience and local charm. You’ll find a variety of cafés, restaurants, and shops within walking distance, as well as nearby green spaces perfect for relaxing outdoors.

title: Friedrich-Karl-Straße, Berlin
description:
English version

Bright and beautifully furnished maisonette attic apartment with a south-facing roof terrace, located in the quiet rear building of a fully renovated Berlin Altbau at Friedrich-Karl-Straße , 12103 Berlin-Tempelhof.

The building combines classic Berlin Altbau charm with modern comfort. The apartment is located on the 3rd floor of the rear building and offers a wonderfully open and airy living atmosphere, with a maisonette layout, gallery level and a sunny private terrace.

The location is very well connected: the U6 underground line, bus M46 and bus lines 170 and 184 are all within walking distance. The S-Bahn Ring can be reached after only two U-Bahn stops. Friedrichstraße, Bergmannkiez, City West and many other parts of Berlin are easily accessible by public transport. The city motorway is also close by.

Tempelhofer Feld is only about a 10-minute walk away — perfect for jogging, cycling, long walks or simply relaxing outdoors. Shops, supermarkets, pharmacies, doctors, schools, parks and everything needed for daily life are available in the immediate surroundings.

The apartment offers two bedrooms, a large living kitchen, daylight bathroom, guest toilet, gallery/workspace, storage room and a beautiful south-facing terrace. The main bedroom is furnished with a high-quality box-spring bed and a walk-in closet. The second bedroom has a double bed, chest of drawers and small wardrobe. The gallery area is ideal as a bright workspace.

The spacious living kitchen includes an extendable dining table up to 2.40 m, designer chairs and a fully equipped kitchen with Nespresso machine, microwave and everything needed for everyday living.

The south-facing terrace, furnished with a garden table and four chairs, is perfect for sunny breakfasts or relaxed dinners at sunset. Ideal for a couple with an additional adult or a family with up to two children.

Deutsche Version

Sehr helle und hochwertig möblierte Maisonette-Dachgeschosswohnung mit Südterrasse im ruhigen Hinterhaus eines kernsanierten Berliner Altbaus in der Friedrich-Karl-Straße , 12103 Berlin-Tempelhof.

Das Gebäude verbindet klassischen Berliner Altbaucharme mit modernem Wohnkomfort. Die Wohnung befindet sich im 3. Obergeschoss des Hinterhauses und bietet durch ihre Maisonette-Struktur, die Galerieebene und die sonnige Dachterrasse ein besonders offenes, luftiges Wohngefühl.

Die Lage ist hervorragend angebunden: U6, Bus M46 sowie die Buslinien 170 und 184 sind fußläufig erreichbar. Die S-Bahn-Ringbahn erreicht man bereits nach zwei U-Bahn-Stationen. Friedrichstraße, Bergmannkiez, City West und viele weitere Berliner Stadtteile sind bequem erreichbar. Auch die Stadtautobahn liegt in unmittelbarer Nähe. Das Tempelhofer Feld ist nur etwa 10 Minuten zu Fuß entfernt — ideal zum Joggen, Radfahren, Spazierengehen oder Entspannen. Einkaufsmöglichkeiten, Ärzte, Apotheken, Schulen, Parks und alles für den täglichen Bedarf befinden sich in der direkten Umgebung.

Die Wohnung verfügt über zwei Schlafzimmer, eine große Wohnküche, ein Tageslichtbad, Gäste-WC, Galerie-/Arbeitsbereich, Abstellkammer und eine schöne Südterrasse. Das Hauptschlafzimmer ist mit einem hochwertigen Boxspringbett und begehbarem Kleiderschrank ausgestattet. Das zweite Schlafzimmer verfügt über ein Doppelbett, Kommode und kleinen Schrank. Die Galerie eignet sich ideal als heller Arbeitsbereich.

Die Wohnküche bietet einen ausziehbaren Esstisch bis 2,40 m, Designerstühle und eine vollständig ausgestattete Küche mit Nespresso-Maschine, Mikrowelle und allem, was man im Alltag benötigt.

Auf der Südterrasse laden Gartentisch und vier Stühle zum Frühstück in der Sonne oder Abendessen im Sonnenuntergang ein. Ideal für ein Paar mit zusätzlichem Erwachsenen oder eine Familie mit bis zu zwei Kindern.

title: Friedrich-Karl-Straße, Berlin
description:
Please note: This apartment has one large separate bedroom and one spacious living kitchen. The living kitchen includes a fully equipped kitchen, dining area and living area with a large sofa bed for two people. It is therefore ideal for a couple, a single tenant, or occasional guests — but it does not have two separate bedrooms.

Beautifully furnished garden-level apartment with separate entrance in a fully refurbished Berlin Altbau at Friedrich-Karl-Straße 27, 12103 Berlin-Tempelhof.

The building was originally built in 1908 and combines classic Berlin Altbau charm with modern comfort. The apartment is located in the front building at souterrain / garden level and has its own separate entrance, offering a high level of privacy.

The location is very convenient: the U6 underground line, bus M46 and bus lines 170 and 184 are all nearby. The S-Bahn Ring can be reached after only two U-Bahn stops. Friedrichstraße, Bergmannkiez, City West and many other parts of Berlin are easily accessible by public transport. The city motorway is also close by.

Tempelhofer Feld is only about a 10-minute walk away — perfect for jogging, cycling, walks or relaxing outdoors. Shops, supermarkets, pharmacies, doctors, parks, playgrounds and everything needed for daily life are available in the immediate surroundings.

The apartment offers a very large and beautifully furnished bedroom with a high-quality box-spring bed, walk-in closet, mahogany desk and comfortable armchair. The spacious living kitchen includes a fully equipped fitted kitchen, dining area and living area with a large sofa bed for two.

The kitchen is fully equipped with oven, hob, dishwasher, Nespresso machine, kettle, dishes, cutlery, knives and all essential kitchen equipment.

The bathroom is a real highlight: newly renovated, with natural stone pebble flooring, a large corner bathtub with shower option, and a separate toilet.

A stylish, private and fully equipped apartment — ideal for comfortable temporary living in Berlin.

*******************************************************************************************************

Bitte beachten: 
Diese Wohnung verfügt über ein großes separates Schlafzimmer und eine großzügige Wohnküche. Die Wohnküche besteht aus einer vollständig ausgestatteten Küche, einem Essbereich und einem Wohnbereich mit großem Schlafsofa für zwei Personen. Die Wohnung eignet sich daher ideal für eine Einzelperson, ein Paar oder gelegentliche Gäste — sie verfügt jedoch nicht über zwei getrennte Schlafzimmer.

Sehr schön möblierte Souterrainwohnung mit separatem Eingang in einem vollständig sanierten Berliner Altbau in der Friedrich-Karl-Straße , 12103 Berlin-Tempelhof.

Das Haus wurde ursprünglich im Jahr 1908 erbaut und verbindet klassischen Berliner Altbaucharme mit modernem Wohnkomfort. Die Wohnung befindet sich im Vorderhaus im Souterrain bzw. Gartengeschoss und verfügt über einen eigenen separaten Eingang, der viel Privatsphäre bietet.

Die Lage ist sehr praktisch: Die U-Bahn-Linie U6, der Bus M46 sowie die Buslinien 170 und 184 befinden sich in direkter Nähe. Die S-Bahn-Ringbahn ist bereits nach zwei U-Bahn-Stationen erreichbar. Friedrichstraße, Bergmannkiez, City West und viele weitere Berliner Stadtteile sind bequem mit öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln erreichbar. Auch die Stadtautobahn liegt in der Nähe.

Die Wohnung bietet ein sehr großes und hochwertig eingerichtetes Schlafzimmer mit komfortablem Boxspringbett, begehbarem Kleiderschrank, Mahagoni-Schreibtisch und gemütlichem Sessel. Die großzügige Wohnküche umfasst eine voll ausgestattete Einbauküche, einen Essbereich sowie einen Wohnbereich mit großem Schlafsofa für zwei Personen.

Die Küche ist vollständig ausgestattet mit Backofen, Kochfeld, Geschirrspüler, Nespresso-Maschine, Wasserkocher, Geschirr, Besteck, Messern und allen wichtigen Küchenutensilien.

Ein besonderes Highlight ist das sehr schöne, sanierte Badezimmer mit Natursteinkieselboden, großer Eckbadewanne mit Duschmöglichkeit sowie separater Toilette.

Eine stilvolle, private und vollständig ausgestattete Wohnung — ideal für komfortables Wohnen auf Zeit in Berlin.

title: Friedrich-Karl-Straße, Berlin
description:
The building is a completely renovated Berlin "Altbau" building and is in the immediate vicinity of public transport and the city motorway. 10 minutes walk to Tempelhofer Feld. All infrastructure for daily needs is in the immediate vicinity. The U6 subway line and several bus lines are within walking distance. The public transport connection is good, i.e. “Friedrichstr:” in 20 minutes, “BergmanKiez” in 10 minutes or City West with the M46.
There are several parks, green spaces, and playgrounds nearby, illustrating the neighborhood's lush character.

The apartment is a very bright ground-floor unit with a terrace. The bedroom has a large wardrobe, a luxurious box-spring bed (200 × 200 cm), and a bright workspace. The terrace features a bistro table and two garden chairs, perfect for relaxing or enjoying dinner at sunset. The kitchen has a fitted kitchen and is fully equipped. The bathroom has natural daylight and includes a shower. The entire apartment is furnished to a very high standard.


********************************************
Das Gebäude ist ein kernsanierter Berliner Altbau und liegt in unmittelbarer Nähe zu öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln (U 6, S-Bahn Ring, Buslinien etc.) sowie zur Stadtautobahn. 10 min Fußweg zum Tempelhofer Feld und alle Infrastrukturen des täglichen Bedarfs sind in unmittelbarer Nähe. Die U-Bahnlinie U6, sowie mehrere Buslinien sind fußläufig erreichbar. Die ÖPNV-Anbindung ist gut, d.h. „Friedrichstr:“ in 20 Minuten, „BergmanKiez“ in 10 Minuten oder die City West mit dem M46.
Es gibt mehrere Parks, Grünflächen und Spielplätze in der Nähe, die den üppigen Charakter der Nachbarschaft veranschaulichen.

Die Wohnung ist eine sehr helle Erdgeschoss Wohnung mit Terrasse. Das Schlafzimmer hat einen großen Kleiderschrank, ein luxuriöses Boxspringbett (200 x 200 cm) und einen hellen Arbeitsplatz.. Die Terrasse hat einen Bistro Tisch 2 Gartenstühlen zum Verweilen, und Abendessen im Sonnenuntergang. Die Küche verfügt über eine Einbauküche und ist voll ausgestattet . Das Bad verfügt über Tageslicht und ist mit einer Dusche. Die gesamte Wohnung ist sehr hochwertig eingerichtet

title: Friedrich-Karl-Straße, Berlin
description:
English version

Beautifully furnished 2-bedroom apartment with balcony in a renovated Berlin Altbau, located at Friedrich-Karl-Straße , 12103 Berlin-Tempelhof.

The building was originally built in 1908 and has been carefully renovated, combining classic Berlin Altbau charm with modern comfort. The apartment is located on the first floor of the quiet rear building, offering a pleasant and peaceful living atmosphere while still being very well connected to the city.

The location is ideal for anyone looking for a comfortable temporary home in Berlin. The U6 underground line, bus M46, bus lines 170 and 184 are all close by, and the S-Bahn Ring can be reached after only two U-Bahn stops. By public transport, you can easily reach Kreuzberg, Friedrichstraße, City West and many other parts of Berlin. The city motorway is also nearby, making the apartment convenient for car users as well.

Tempelhofer Feld is only about a 10-minute walk away — perfect for jogging, cycling, walks or relaxing outdoors. Shops, supermarkets, pharmacies, doctors, schools, parks and everything needed for daily life are available in the immediate surroundings.

The apartment offers two separate bedrooms. Each room is furnished with a large 200 x 200 cm box-spring bed, a spacious wardrobe, a desk and a chair. One of the rooms also has access to a lovely green balcony with a small bistro table and two chairs.

The kitchen has been completely newly renovated and is fully equipped with a dishwasher, sink, oven, induction hob, extractor hood, kettle, cutlery, dishes, knives and all essential kitchen equipment.

A stylish, bright and fully equipped apartment — ideal for professionals, couples, students or two people sharing.

Deutsche Version

Sehr schöne, möblierte 2-Zimmer-Wohnung mit Balkon in einem sanierten Berliner Altbau in der Friedrich-Karl-Straße , 12103 Berlin-Tempelhof.

Das Haus wurde ursprünglich im Jahr 1908 erbaut und verbindet klassischen Berliner Altbaucharme mit modernem Wohnkomfort. Die Wohnung befindet sich im 1. Obergeschoss des ruhigen Hinterhauses und bietet dadurch eine angenehme, geschützte Wohnatmosphäre — bei gleichzeitig sehr guter Anbindung an die Stadt.

Die Lage ist ideal für alle, die in Berlin auf Zeit wohnen möchten. Die U-Bahn-Linie U6, der Bus M46 sowie die Buslinien 170 und 184 befinden sich in direkter Nähe. Die S-Bahn-Ringbahn ist bereits nach zwei U-Bahn-Stationen erreichbar. Dadurch gelangt man bequem nach Kreuzberg, Friedrichstraße, City West und in viele weitere Stadtteile. Auch die Stadtautobahn ist schnell erreichbar.

Das Tempelhofer Feld liegt nur etwa 10 Minuten zu Fuß entfernt und bietet viel Platz zum Joggen, Radfahren, Spazierengehen oder Entspannen. Einkaufsmöglichkeiten, Supermärkte, Apotheken, Ärzte, Schulen, Parks und alles für den täglichen Bedarf befinden sich in der unmittelbaren Umgebung.

Die Wohnung verfügt über zwei separate Schlafzimmer. Beide Zimmer sind jeweils mit einem großen 200 x 200 cm Boxspringbett, einem geräumigen Kleiderschrank sowie einem Schreibtisch mit Stuhl ausgestattet. Eines der Zimmer hat zusätzlich Zugang zu einem schönen Balkon im Grünen mit kleinem Bistrotisch und zwei Stühlen.

Die Küche wurde komplett neu saniert und ist voll ausgestattet: Geschirrspüler, Spüle, Backofen, Induktionskochfeld, Dunstabzugshaube, Wasserkocher sowie Besteck, Geschirr, Messer und die wichtigsten Küchenutensilien sind vorhanden.

Eine hochwertige, helle und vollständig ausgestattete Wohnung — ideal für Berufstätige, Paare, Studierende oder zwei Personen, die gemeinsam wohnen möchten.

title: Wittelsbacherstraße, Berlin
description:
The beautiful, bright and spacious 1-room apartment is located on the 3rd floor of a 5-storey residential building and is easily accessible by elevator. The bath tub, a cozy south-facing balcony with views of the quiet courtyard and a beautiful wooden floor in the living area are just a few of the many highlights that the beautiful apartment has to offer! Due to the orientation, direct sunlight is present throughout the day.

Features: 

Living area: 
- sideboard
- flat screen TV
- dining table + 2 chairs
- armchair 
- lot of storage space
- floor lamp
- bed (200x140cm) + bed linen
- iron + ironing board 
- vacuum cleaner

Kitchen: 
- fitted kitchen with ceramic hobs
- fridge with freezer compartment
- microwave
- sink
- coffee maker
- washing machine
- dishes
- toaster
- cooking utensils

Bathroom: 
- bath + toilet + sink
- washbasin cabinet
- towel rail

Area:
The apartment is located in the heart of West Berlin between Ku'damm and Preußenpark. The Ku'damm and thus the underground stations Adenauer Platz and Konstanzer Straße are each within walking distance in a few minutes. The motorway access Hohenzollerndamm (A100) can be reached by car in about 5 minutes and the exhibition center in about 10 minutes. The famous "ThaiPark" in the Preußenpark is just around the corner, a 5-minute walk away. Surrounding you will find various shopping and shopping opportunities as well as a variety of gastronomic highlights and bars of the newly bustling West Berlin.
 
Due to the good connection to the public transport network, the apartment is ideal for business people who live and work weekdays in the capital, as it is quiet but right in the center!

title: Homburger Straße, Berlin
description: This two-bedroom apartment is right where Rheingauviertel is at its best. After a long day, the bathtub is your personal retreat. You'll find a washing machine, dishwasher, coffee machine, Smart TV — everything's included. Nearby: garden terraces with an English country feel and Rüdesheimer Platz with its Art Nouveau fountain and wine festival. U Rüdesheimer Platz (U3) takes you to Wittenbergplatz in about 10 minutes. The Rheingauviertel feels more like a garden suburb than a city neighborhood — quiet streets, greenery everywhere, and a pace of life that lets you breathe.

title: Cicerostraße, Berlin
description:
Fully modern and equipped 3-room apartment in landmark building close by the Ku'Damm boulevard.
The apartment is uniquely central at 30 to 45 min from airport and central train station. 
The unique living experience is created by a spacious living room opening to a spacious balcony combining architecutral landmark  with fully modern amenities. The kitchen is fully equipped with a built in ventilation system. Each of the 3 rooms is equipped with a wardrobe and offers a perfect accommodation for up to 4 people.

title: Kurfürstendamm, Berlin
description:
Apartment with a separate bedroom and entrance area. Modern living room with an open-plan kitchen. Modern bathroom with built-in underfloor heating. The apartment is quietly situated in an absolute prime central location in Berlin.

50 meters from Ku'Damm and all public transportation (bus / U-Bahn / trains). The apartment is modernly furnished for guests who need to work in Berlin for extended periods.

title: Crailsheimer Straße, Berlin
description:
Der exklusive Neubau unserer Apartments befindet sich inmitten des wunderschönen und grünen Bezirks Steglitz,
unweit vom Steglitzer Damm und diversen Nahverkehrsmöglichkeiten, wie S-Bhf Südende (5 min Fußweg) und dem Busverkehr.
Die belebte Einkaufsmeile, Schloßstrasse , mit mehreren Einkaufszentren, Restaurants/Cafés und Unterhaltungsmöglichkeiten (Theater, Kino), ist mit dem Bus erreichbar und in Ihrer unmittelbaren Nähe.
Zahlreiche Aktivitäten, wie der Botanische Garten, das Schlosspark Theater etc., befinden sich ebenfalls in erreichbarer Umgebung.
Die Freie Universität Berlin und die Charité  sind ebenfalls sehr gut erreichbar und in Ihrer Nähe.
 
Jedes unserer hochmodernen 1-Zimmer Apartments ist exklusiv ausgestattet mit:

- Video-Gegensprechanlage
- Terrasse/Balkon
- Fußbodenheizung
- Boxspringbett (140 x 200) mit Bettwäsche
- Schreibtisch mit Arbeitslampe
- Kleiderschrank mit Spiegel
- Bügelbrett und Bügeleisen
- Wäscheständer

Weiterhin verfügt das Apartment über ein sehr geräumiges Badezimmer mit barrierefreier Dusche und Regal (inkl. Handtücher).

Unsere exklusiv ausgestattete Küche verfügt über:
- Besteck/Geschirr
- Küchenutensilien
- zwei Kochplatten
- Kühlschrank mit Gefrierfach
- Kaffeemaschine (Senseo)
- Wasserkocher

Waschmaschinen und Wäschetrockner stehen im Gebäude (UG) zur kostenlosen Nutzung zur Verfügung.

title: Mittenwalder Straße, Berlin
description:
DUE TO A LOT OF REQUESTS PLEASE SENT ME A BOOKING REQUEST IMMEDIATELY!

Quiet and sunny apartment, freshly renovated, (35 sqm) located on the second floor in a building from the beginning of the century. Mittenwalde Strasse itself is a quiet side street, with old buildings in a Wilhelminian style typical of Berlin.

The apartment is furnished and decorated with taste and plenty of nice details, fitted with parquet flooring using genuine wood; there is a modern fitted kitchen and balcony. Branded products have been used exclusively for sanitary items and fittings. The living room is furnished with a double bed, sofa, chest of drawers, table and 2 chairs and television. The kitchen is furnished with all things that are necessary for cooking and eating, fridge/freezer, gas stove with 4 plates and oven.

GneisenaustrasseU-Bahn is just 50 m from the property, and numerous localbusroutes link the property to PotsdamerPlatz, Kurfurstendamm and Alexanderplatz.

The beautiful Viktoriapark with waterfall and Schinkel Memorial, offering fantastic views of Berlin, is just 2 minutes away on foot. The popular Bergmannstrasse with many attractive cafes, shops and restaurants and the Chamisso quarter with decorative stucco buildings are also nearby on foot. Potsdamer Platz (1 km)and Tiergarten are only about 1.5 km away and Kurfuerstendamm (KaDeWe) about 2 km.

Another 2-minute walk in a different direction takes you to the top of the Kreuzberg in Viktoria Park, the highest geographical elevation of Berlin with the famous liberty monument (Freiheitsdenkmal) by architect Friedrich Schinkel. This vantage point affords a most magnificent 360-degree view overlooking the entire city. It is also the spot that gives Kreuzberg its name.

Please be aware that HousingAnywhere is an online booking platform. Therefore exchanging contact details and offering viewings is not possible. If you would like to reserve this accommodation, send me a booking request or a message and please mention your age and occupation. I look forward to meeting you!

title: Wilhelmshöher Straße, Berlin
description:
ATTENTION
The flat is not quite finished yet, but for a first impression it may be enough.

Take a look at this lovely flat in Berlin!

The 2-room flat is located on the 3rd floor in a quiet side street about 500 m from the subway station Friedrich-Wlhelm-Platz. For students, the FU and TU are not far away. The Freie Universität is about 5 km away and the Technische Universität is about 11 km away.

The flat is newly renovated and completely refurbished with modern light oak furniture. It is equipped with a fully equipped, modern kitchen. The small, comfortable sitting area invites you to have a cosy meal or to retreat to read or work on the computer.  It offers the resident plenty of storage space with its many cupboards. The refrigerator has a freezer compartment. 

In the living room, the tenant will find a comfortable seating area consisting of a pull-out couch and a wing chair, a TV bench and a small secretary.

The small modern bathroom has a ground-level shower with glass wall, the large mirror brings a little space into the room.

The bedroom has a wardrobe as well as a linen cupboard and offers the tenant enough possibilities to store his clothes, the double bed is 1,60X200.  In the small alcove there is a console table, a mirror conjures up even more light in the room. For the night, the curtains darken the room completely. 

Please be aware that HousingAnywhere is an online booking platform. Therefore, exchanging contact details and offering viewings is not possible. If you would like to reserve this accommodation, send me a booking request or a message, and please mention your age and occupation. I look forward to meeting you!

title: Hindenburgdamm, Berlin
description:
Hey, are you looking for a comfortable and convenient place to call a temporary home in Berlin? Look no further! We have a beautifully furnished room available in a newly refurbished shared flat located in the heart of Berlin Steglitz. It is fully furnished with a comfortable 140x200 bed, a desk with office chair and spacious closet. The large garden can be used by all residents of the house and offers a seating and barbecue area with plenty of space to relax. 

A highlight of the apartment is its location, here you are just a short ride away from the bustling city life and the peaceful greenery that Berlin is known for. Rathaus Steglitz is just a short walk away offering ideal connection to public transportation including S and U Bahn and many buses. The FU Berlin (Freie Universität Berlin) is just a short commute away (10 min by bike) making this the perfect spot for students! The Schloßstraße, one of the largest shopping areas in Berlin, is just a short walk-away with its numerous shops, cafés, restaurants and bars.
The flat has been freshly refurbished to the highest standards. Enjoy the sleek, modern bathroom and a brand-new kitchen equipped with a fringe, dishwasher and cooking facility.

It is important to us that every resident feels comfortable and at home. This also means that mutual agreements and respectful communication are an integral part of everyday life in our shared flat. We are looking forward to getting to know you a little better in a short introduction and creating a positive and harmonious living atmosphere together.

The monthly all-inclusive rent not only covers all utilities, but also includes normal electricity consumption and internet. Minimum rental period is 6 month, maximum rental period 24 months. 

Additional Features:
•	High-speed internet for seamless online classes and entertainment
•	Close to public transport, shops, supermarkets, cafes, and parks. The Schloßstraße is just a short walk away with its numerous shops, restaurants, bars and cafés. The close-by Berlin botanical gardens are ideal for relaxing walks and some time-out in the Green.

title: Crellestraße, Berlin
description:
Quiet 1 double Bedroom Altbau Apartment with Balcony & Workspace – Schoenenerg Courtyard Oasis (Anmeldung Possible), fully furnished and move-in ready.

This is a gorgeous 1 double bedroom Altbau apartment with balcony overlooking a leafy green courtyard in central Schöneberg. Registration (Anmeldung) possible, all utilities and WiFi included.

The Apartment
This peaceful and beautifully renovated Altbau apartment is located on one of the most charming, leafy and quiet streets in the historic Crellekiez neighbourhood of Schöneberg.

Situated inside a restored late-19th-century building, the apartment retains classic Berlin architectural details including original wooden floors, high ceilings and elegant brass fittings, creating a warm and authentic Altbau atmosphere.

The apartment offers a rare and comfortable layout for its size, with a separate bedroom, and dedicated workspace with a window overlooking a leafy courtyard, as well as living room and bathroom and balcony.

Layout:
• separate bedroom with double bed (160 cm)
• bright large living room including open kitchen
• modern bathroom
• balcony overlooking the courtyard
• hallway entrance area
Because the apartment faces a private green courtyard, it remains very quiet despite its central location.

The bright living room with open kitchen opens onto a charming wooden balcony through two full-length glass doors.
From here you look out over a leafy courtyard garden, where neighbours have created a small green oasis of flowers, plants and decorated balconies.
Both  provide pleasant spaces for eating, working or relaxing.
The atmosphere is peaceful and private while remaining in the centre of the city.
The sofa turns into a double sofa bed for guests when needed. 

Bedroom & Dedicated Workspace
The cozy bedroom faces the same quiet courtyard and enjoys natural light and a calm atmosphere.
The room includes:
• a comfortable double bed (160 cm)
• storage space for clothes and hanging space for clothes
• a built-in desk by the window
The dedicated desk workspace makes the apartment especially comfortable for remote working professionals, researchers or creatives spending extended time in Berlin.

The modern open kitchen-living room is fully equipped for everyday cooking and dining. 
The modern spacious bathroom includes: shower, sink and mirror, cupboards and storage, washing machine, drying rack. A window provides natural light and ventilation.
Kitchen has 
• stove and oven

Household

A clean, dry, lockable cellar storage space is also available for suitcases or larger items.

Location – Crellekiez / Schöneberg
Crellestrasse is one of the most beautiful historic streets in Schöneberg, known for its cobblestones, mature cherry trees and charming pedestrian areas.
The neighbourhood has long been part of Berlin’s creative history and was home to artists and writers including Christopher Isherwood, David Bowie and Marlene Dietrich.
Today the Crellekiez is known for its welcoming atmosphere, independent cafés, restaurants, art galleries and weekly farmers market.
The nearby Akazienkiez area offers even more cafés, bakeries, restaurants and shops within a short walk.

Die Küche ist vollständig ausgestattet und verfügt über eine Waschmaschine, einen großen Kühlschrank mit Gefrierfach, einen Backofen, Toaster, Wasserkocher, eine Kaffeemaschine sowie komplettes Geschirr und Kochutensilien. Das moderne Badezimmer ist mit einer Dusche ausgestattet.

Die Wohnung wurde im Oktober 2024 frisch renoviert und geschmackvoll modernisiert: Das neue Sofa, die hochwertige Matratze sowie ein stilvoller Schreibtisch mit passendem Stuhl sorgen für zusätzlichen Komfort und ein angenehmes Wohngefühl.

Diese Wohnung eignet sich ideal für Expats, Berufstätige, Studierende oder digitale Nomaden, die eine voll ausgestattete, zentrale und ruhige Unterkunft in Berlin mit hervorragender Verkehrsanbindung suchen. Eine Anmeldung beim Einwohnermeldeamt ist möglich.

title: Kreuzbergstraße, Berlin
description:
Apartment

The apartment itself consists of a large room well-divided into:
- sleeping area (large bed with side table and side lamps)
- dining area (new table with 4 chairs)
- relaxing area (bright corner with a large sofa and a lower table)
3 new matching lamps (for ceiling, floor and bed) cannot be seen in the attached pictures.

The kitchen is fully equipped with refrigerator, modern cooking plate and oven, toaster, kettle, coffee machine and all the cooking equipment/utensils you may need.
The washing machine is the bathroom,
together with a modern shower and a couple of cabinets.

Location

This beautiful studio was newly renovated and is centrally located in Kreuzberg between two big city parks called Viktoria and Flaschenhal (southern part of Gleis-Dreieck Park). It lies at the first floor of a respectful old building and faces a quiet courtyard with trees. The large windows, the high ceiling and especially the wooden-tiled floor in the apartment, they all give a "ALTBAU" flair and special comfort.

title: Spilstraße, Berlin
description:
Bright 2-room apartment with separate bedroom near FU Berlin (Dahlem)

This fully furnished and tastefully decorated apartment offers both comfort and convenience in one of Berlin’s most pleasant residential areas.

Just a 2-minute walk from the nearest U-Bahn station and 1 minute from the bus stop, it provides excellent public transport connections. Restaurants, cafés, supermarkets, and small local shops are all within easy walking distance. The neighborhood is quiet and respectful, surrounded by greenery and close to the Grunewald forest, the Botanic Garden, and Grunewaldsee, offering plenty of space for outdoor activities and relaxation.

The apartment is bright and well laid out. A spacious living room with large windows opens directly onto a sunny rooftop terrace—perfect for enjoying fresh air or a morning coffee. The open-plan kitchen is fully equipped with modern appliances and all cooking essentials, and there is also a dedicated working area ideal for home office needs.

The bedroom is elegantly furnished with a comfortable double bed and a large wardrobe providing ample storage space. The bathroom, accessible from a practical entrance hall, features a bathtub, washing machine, and a window ensuring natural light and ventilation.

All furniture and fittings are of good quality, combining functionality with a clean, modern design. The apartment has a fast and reliable internet connection, and the building’s residents are quiet, friendly, and respectful.

This apartment offers a high standard of living and is an excellent choice for a mid- to long-term stay in Berlin. Registration (Anmeldung) is possible.

title: Gotenstraße, Berlin
description:
The apartment is located in the beautiful quarter of Schöneberg (Gotenstrasse) on the 2th floor of a courtyard building,  making it cosy and quiet but also close to a lively area. It displays typical features of german historical buildings (ALT-Bau) like the original doors and wooden floor boards.
At the entrance there is a practical long coat-hanger and a very large mirror (to check the outfit and more...). In the bathroom a comfortable spacious shower, sink with a mirror, washing machine and a tall closet for cleaning supplies as well as room for many toiletries.
The main space is cleverly divided into a sleeping and a living area. The double bed has drawers for extra storage and can be separated with curtains for more comfort and privacy. There is also a large wardrobe for many clothes and even more separation. 
The living area features TV board, sofa, table with chairs and a desk to work or study. The 3-seat sofa has drawers for even more storage.
The kitchen is fully equipped with utensils to cook, bake, eat, drink, etc. and there is a proper kitchen table for up to 4 seats. There are further household appliances like a regular high-temperature oven, an exhaust hood, microwave oven, toaster, water kettle, coffee machine, etc. .
The nice, safe and respectful neighbourhood features many international restaurants, bars, small old-time shops, supermarkets and green areas to relax, like Kian Park and Gasometer park.  Just a few steps away the S-Bahn station Julius-Leber-Brücke, where the S1 and S2 trains lead directly to Potsdamer Platz, Branderburger Tor, Friedrichstrasse, Südkreuz and even to the lakes area of Wannse . The closeby bus station for lines 106 and 204 to get to other city areas.
Fast flatrate WLAN connection is included in the rent.
Anmeldung is possible.

title: Holsteinische Straße, Berlin
description:
This bright and welcoming apartment has been recently renovated. The kitchen is brand-new, and most of the furniture has been newly added.

Situated on the second floor of a charming building surrounded by tall trees, the apartment offers a peaceful retreat in the heart of the city.

The living room offers a comfortable king-size bed, a sofa, a table with  chairs and a desk. a drawer and a closets. The bathroom and the kitchen are equipped with everything (cutlery, flatware, cooking utensils).
The quiet balcony has a back yard view that invites to just sit and relax.
The apartment provides household appliances such as fridge, microwave, toaster, coffee machine, kettel, vacum cleaner, washing machine, flatiron and ironing board.

Location
The apartment lies in a green quiet side road in the lively area of Wilmersdorf, on the border to Schöneberg, close the beautiful Viktoria-Luise-Platz and the famous Ku'damm. The area offers a large selection of bars, restaurants, cafés, shops and many night-life attractions. The world known KaDeWe (Department Store of the West) can be reached with a small walk.
There are two metro station nearby: Berliner Str (line U9 and U7) and Blisse Str (line U7). The U9 leads in 2 stops to the big station Zoologischer Garten, crossing of many lines, for example the central S-Bahn to Friedrichstrasse and Alexanderplatz. The Nollendorfplatz station is then only 2 stops away with the U3, or reachable on foot.

title: Lietzenburger Straße, Berlin
description:
Sun-Drenched Studio in Schöneberg – Prime Location Near KaDeWe

Discover the perfect urban retreat in one of Berlin’s most sought-after neighborhoods. This charming 1-room studio apartment offers a bright, open atmosphere with total privacy—perfect for a single professional or a couple.

The Space
Sunny & Private: The standout feature is the large, sunny balcony with no "vis-à-vis," meaning you can enjoy your morning coffee or evening sunsets with complete privacy and a clear view.

Smart Layout: Unlike many studios, this apartment features a separate walk-in kitchen, keeping your living and cooking spaces distinct.

Move-In Ready: The flat is fully furnished with everything you need. We provide plenty of fresh sheets, pillows, and blankets—all you need to bring is your suitcase.

Morning Coffee: A Nespresso machine is ready and waiting for you in the kitchen.

Top-Tier Location
Live in the heart of Schöneberg, just a short stroll from the world-famous KaDeWe and the vibrant Wittenbergplatz.

Vibe: You are surrounded by Berlin’s best cafes, boutique shopping, and excellent weekly markets.

Connectivity: Incredible access to the U-Bahn and bus networks, making any commute across Berlin effortless.

Key Details
Occupancy: Suitable for 1 to 2 persons.

Home Comforts: Includes a TV and high-quality furnishings throughout.

House Rules: To keep the space fresh for all guests, this is a non-smoking apartment and pets are not permitted.

title: Berliner Straße, Berlin
description:
Stunning & Spacious Room in a Newly Renovated Altbau – Berlin Wilmersdorf

Looking for a beautiful place to call home? We are renting out the largest room in our magnificent, high-ceilinged apartment. Located on the 5th floor (top floor) of a classic Berlin Altbau, this flat was completely renovated last year to the highest standards.

The Room & The Apartment
Your Room: Extra large, flooded with natural light, and fully furnished with a comfortable double bed and a dedicated desk for working from home.

The Flat: High ceilings, brand-new floors, and modern finishes throughout. Since it’s on the top floor, you’ll enjoy peace and quiet with no neighbors living above you.

Shared Spaces: A large, fully equipped eat-in kitchen (perfect for cooking and socializing) and two bathrooms (one with a bathtub and one with a walk-in shower).

Convenience: We provide all linens, towels, and high-speed internet. What you see in the photos is exactly what you get!

Location & Connectivity
Situated right next to U-Bahn Berliner Straße, you couldn't be better connected.

Transit: The station serves two major lines (U7 and U9), offering easy "vertical and horizontal" access across the entire city.

Amenities: Plenty of shops, supermarkets, and cafes are just a few steps away.

The Details
Flatmates: You will share the apartment with a maximum of 3 other respectful roommates. You will be sharing this apartment with high-achieving PhD students who value a focused and serene environment. Maintaining quiet hours is essential to support everyone's research and rest. Furthermore, hygiene is a core principle of our home; we expect all residents to take pride in keeping the common areas in pristine condition.

Access: The elevator goes to the 4th floor, with one final flight of stairs leading to your top-floor sanctuary.

Availability: Preference will be given to those who can start their lease on March 1st.

Duration: Flexible rental period between 6 to 11 months.

Anmeldung: No problem! We provide the necessary registration (Wohnungsgeberbestätigung) for your paperwork.

Interested? We’d love to tell you more! Please send us a message with a little bit about yourself. We look forward to meeting you!

title: Gutzkowstraße, Berlin
description:
WHO WE ARE:
We are a start-up committed to solely hosting ambitious successful young professionals aged 21-35. We believe that hosting like-minded go-getters is essential for a pleasant flat atmosphere. With your relocation to Berlin to one of our luxurious co-living spaces, you will get direct access to an elite community of carefully selected individuals. You will instantly be integrated in Berlin’s social circle of bright rainmakers.

Renting a room with us can be compared to joining a selective membership club. Ultimately, our mission is to provide aspiring personalities like you, who are newly drawn to Berlin, with prompt communal cohesion and moreover with an extensive network of thriving achievers. Not just within your own co-living space, but also beyond your flat. On a periodical basis, we organize events, where tenants from different co-living spaces come together to enjoy an exciting evening and are moreover given a platform to network and bond. These events can be in form of fancy restaurant dinners, exclusive catered house-parties, long weekend lunches or even personalized pub crawls. Of course, with pleasure, we carry all costs of our highly valued get-togethers.

Regarding living comfort, we have established a new level of luxury in the co-living space segment. All our flats are equipped with the finest furniture highlighted by kingsized box-spring beds, modern fully fitted kitchens as well as all necessary appliances and utensils one might need in an apartment. Every flat of ours has been individually furnished with an eye for warmth and detail. Furthermore, we only choose prime locations for our apartments. Our shared flats can primarily be found in Berlin's most fancy and central residential area: Westend.

With us, the rent you pay is an all-inclusive rent. No headaches, no subsequent payments or hidden costs. Everything is included: electricity, very fast 100 Mbit/s internet, water, heating and washing machine costs. You also don’t have to worry about any administrative TO DOs like city registration for example. We will take care of everything. Moreover, we offer a 24/7 Community Member Service for any issue that may arise, may it be a simplerestaurant recommendation, city bureaucracy questions or any form of personal emergency.

We carefully select every member of our community and thus fully trust them; this is also why we are the only co-living player on the market that does not require a deposit. We believe that our non-deposit policy liberates our clients from unnecessary financial burdens and gives them more flexibility within their fast-paced career lifestyles.

YOUR ROOM:
The room is particularly bright with an amazing balcony. The room is equipped with a king-sized box-spring bed with fine bedding as well as two bedside tables, a chest of drawers, a large mirror, a working desk with a corresponding chair, a floor lamp and a large closet. In addition to your own room, you and your (hidden) share a spacious kitchen with a seating corner. Moreover, the kitchen is fully fitted with cooking equipment and utensils. Furthermore, the bathroom has a bathtub shower and a washing machine.

DEPOSIT:
To make your move easier, we offer flexible deposit options. You may choose between a one-time, non-refundable non-deposit fee of EUR 560, or a refundable security deposit of 3 months rent, which will be returned after move-out in accordance with standard regulations.

LOCATION:
The room is located in a very beautiful and well-maintained old building in the middle of the lively Berlin district Schöneberg! Ideal for interns and young professionals as it is close to the center of Berlin. The next metro station can be reached by foot within few minutes. The district impresses by its very trendy and colourful style. Charming cafes, bars and restaurants are within walking distance. Furthermore, nearby parks and sedate streets will give you opportunities to calm down and find quiet.

title: Bahnhofstraße, Berlin
description:
Experience the vibrant heart of modern city life in Berlin Schöneberg Area Friedenau, in this elegant apartment with a generous living space of 67 square meters. Carefully designed, this apartment perfectly combines style and functionality. The apartment presents itself with a well-thought-out layout, consisting of two room: a welcoming hallway that gives a sense of harmony as soon as you enter, and a spacious bedroom and very charming livingroom.  A special highlight is the new kitchen, equipped with a fully functional kitchen and a modern bathroom with shower an bathtub. Enjoy the luxury of a brand new box spring bed. A spacious wardrobe and high-definition 4K TV will meet all your needs, whether it's productivity or relaxation. 

Erleben Sie das pulsierende Herz des modernen Stadtlebens im Berliner Stadtteil Schöneberg Friedenau in dieser eleganten Wohnung mit einer großzügigen Wohnfläche von 67 Quadratmetern. Diese sorgfältig gestaltete Wohnung verbindet Stil und Funktionalität perfekt. Die Wohnung präsentiert sich mit einem durchdachten Grundriss, bestehend aus zwei Räumen: einem einladenden Flur, der schon beim Betreten ein Gefühl von Harmonie vermittelt, einem geräumigen Schlafzimmer und einem sehr charmanten Wohnzimmer. Ein besonderes Highlight ist die neue Küche, ausgestattet mit einer voll funktionsfähigen Einbauküche und einem modernen Badezimmer mit Dusche und Badewanne. Genießen Sie den Luxus eines brandneuen Boxspringbetts. Ein geräumiger Kleiderschrank und ein hochauflösender 4K-Fernseher erfüllen alle Ihre Bedürfnisse, egal ob Produktivität oder Entspannung.

title: Feurigstraße, Berlin
description:
Apartment Listing – 1-Bedroom and 1 Livingroom Altbau Apartment with Balcony in Berlin-Schöneberg
This charming  Altbau apartment is located on the first floor of a well-maintained building in a quiet side street in the heart of Berlin-Schöneberg. It features beautiful period details such as high ceilings, wooden floorboards, and ornate stucco.

The fully furnished apartment (approx. 60 m2) includes:

Living room with a comfortable sofa, dining table, and TV

Bedroom with a 160 cm wide box spring bed and wardrobe

Fitted kitchen with refrigerator, washing machine, and essential kitchenware

Modern bathroom with a bathtub

Balcony – perfect for relaxing

Enjoy peace and quiet while being centrally located – shops, cafés, restaurants, and public transport are all within walking distance.

Perfect for singles or couples who appreciate the charm of a classic Berlin Altbau apartment in a prime location.

Wohnungsanzeige – 2-Zimmer-Altbauwohnung mit Balkon in Berlin-Schöneberg
In einer ruhigen Seitenstraße im Herzen von Berlin-Schöneberg liegt diese charmante 2-Zimmer-Altbauwohnung im 1. Obergeschoss eines gepflegten Mehrfamilienhauses. Die Wohnung überzeugt durch klassische Altbaudetails wie hohe Decken, Dielenböden und aufwendig gearbeiteten Stuck.

Die ca. 60 m2 große Wohnung ist vollständig möbliert und bietet:

Wohnzimmer mit gemütlichem Sofa, Esstisch und TV

Schlafzimmer mit einem komfortablen 160 cm breiten Boxspringbett und Kleiderschrank

Einbauküche mit Kühlschrank, Waschmaschine und allen wichtigen Küchenutensilien

Modernes Badezimmer mit Badewanne

Balkon – ideal zum Entspannen

Dank der Lage in einer ruhigen Seitenstraße wohnen Sie ruhig, aber dennoch zentral – Einkaufsmöglichkeiten, Cafés, Restaurants und öffentliche Verkehrsmittel sind fußläufig erreichbar.

Ideal für Singles oder Paare, die das Berliner Altbauflair in einer top Lage genießen möchten.

Discover the Vibrant Lifestyle of Berlin: A Hub for Living, Studying, and Working

Berlin, the dynamic capital of Germany, has firmly established itself as a city that seamlessly blends history, culture, and innovation. With its rich heritage, diverse population, and robust economy, Berlin has become a prime destination for individuals seeking a vibrant lifestyle while pursuing their educational and professional aspirations.

A Cultural Melting Pot: Berlin's allure lies in its diverse and inclusive atmosphere. It's a haven for artists, musicians, and creatives from all corners of the globe. The city's historic landmarks, such as the Brandenburg Gate and the Berlin Wall, stand as powerful reminders of its past while providing a backdrop for contemporary expression. The thriving arts scene, world-class museums, and countless galleries offer a continuous source of inspiration.

Educational Excellence: Berlin boasts an array of prestigious universities and research institutions that draw students and academics from around the world. Institutions like Humboldt University and the Technical University of Berlin provide cutting-edge research opportunities and a wide range of study programs. The city's commitment to education is further exemplified by its affordable tuition fees and numerous scholarships available to both local and international students.

Professional Opportunities: As a global economic powerhouse, Berlin offers a plethora of professional opportunities across various industries. The city's startup ecosystem is particularly noteworthy, with its reputation as the "Silicon Allee" drawing tech entrepreneurs and innovators. The low cost of living in comparison to other major European cities further enhances its appeal, allowing individuals to balance a high quality of life with exciting career prospects.

Quality of Life: Berlin consistently ranks high on quality of life indices due to its excellent infrastructure, efficient public transportation system, and well-planned urban spaces. The city's green initiatives, extensive parks, and nearby natural landscapes provide ample opportunities for outdoor activities. A diverse culinary scene, bustling markets, and a myriad of cultural events ensure there's always something to explore and enjoy.

Cultural Exchange: The international makeup of Berlin's population fosters a rich cultural exchange, allowing residents to engage with people from all walks of life. This multicultural environment not only enriches personal experiences but also creates a dynamic backdrop for professional networking and collaboration.

Work-Life Balance: Berlin's relaxed atmosphere and work-life balance set it apart from other major metropolises. The city's emphasis on leisure and recreation ensures that individuals can pursue their passions outside of their professional commitments, contributing to a well-rounded and fulfilling lifestyle.

Berlin's unique blend of history, culture, education, and economic opportunities make it an exceptional city to live, study, and work in. Whether you're captivated by its artistic scene, intrigued by its academic offerings, or seeking a thriving career, Berlin offers a multifaceted environment that fosters personal and professional growth. Embrace the Berlin experience and become a part of a city that celebrates diversity, creativity, and innovation at every turn.

title: Eisenacher Straße, Berlin
description:
Willkommen in Ihrem neuen Zuhause in der Eisenacher Straße, einem gemütlichen Rückzugsort im lebendigen Stadtteil Schöneberg! Dieses stilvoll möblierte Apartment bietet Ihnen modernen Wohnkomfort und eine hervorragende Lage in einem der charmantesten und vielseitigsten Viertel Berlins.

Das Apartment liegt in Schöneberg, einem Bezirk, der für seine bunte Mischung aus Kultur, Geschichte und urbanem Leben bekannt ist. Hier finden Sie das perfekte Gleichgewicht zwischen lebendiger Großstadtatmosphäre und entspanntem Wohnen.

Direkt vor Ihrer Haustür entdecken Sie eine Fülle von Restaurants, Cafés und Bars, die für jeden Geschmack etwas bieten. Genießen Sie internationale Küche, entspannen Sie bei einem Kaffee in einem der vielen gemütlichen Cafés oder lassen Sie den Tag in einer der charmanten Bars ausklingen. Besonders empfehlenswert ist der nahegelegene Winterfeldtplatz mit seinem beliebten Wochenmarkt, auf dem Sie frische und regionale Produkte sowie handgefertigte Spezialitäten finden.

Für Ihre täglichen Besorgungen bieten sich zahlreiche Einkaufsmöglichkeiten an. Von kleinen Boutiquen und Feinkostläden bis hin zu Supermärkten und Drogerien – alles ist bequem zu Fuß erreichbar. Der Nollendorfplatz, ein zentraler Knotenpunkt in Schöneberg, bietet zusätzlich eine Vielzahl an Geschäften und Dienstleistungen.

Natur- und Erholungssuchende werden die Nähe zum Volkspark Schöneberg-Wilmersdorf und zum Rudolph-Wilde-Park schätzen, die beide ideale Orte für Spaziergänge, Jogging oder Picknicks sind.

Die Verkehrsanbindung ist hervorragend. Die U-Bahn-Station Eisenacher Straße und der S-Bahnhof Julius-Leber-Brücke sind nur wenige Gehminuten entfernt und bieten Ihnen schnellen und bequemen Zugang zu allen Teilen Berlins. Ob Sie zur Arbeit pendeln oder die zahlreichen Sehenswürdigkeiten der Stadt erkunden möchten – von hier aus ist alles leicht erreichbar.

Das Apartment selbst ist eine wahre Wohlfühloase. Mit seiner modernen und geschmackvollen Einrichtung bietet es Ihnen ein behagliches Zuhause, in dem Sie sich sofort wohlfühlen werden. Die voll ausgestattete Küche lädt zum Kochen ein, und der helle Wohnbereich ist perfekt zum Entspannen und Verweilen. 

Erleben Sie das Beste von Berlin in Ihrem neuen möblierten Apartment in der Eisenacher Straße 54. Hier vereinen sich urbaner Lebensstil und komfortables Wohnen zu einem einzigartigen Wohnerlebnis, das keine Wünsche offenlässt

Englisch: 
Welcome to your new home on Eisenacher Straße, a cozy retreat in the vibrant district of Schöneberg! This stylishly furnished apartment offers modern living comfort and an excellent location in one of Berlin's most charming and diverse neighborhoods.

The apartment is located in Schöneberg, a district known for its colorful mix of culture, history, and urban life. Here, you'll find the perfect balance between a lively city atmosphere and relaxed living.

Right outside your door, you can discover a wealth of restaurants, cafes, and bars that offer something for every taste. Enjoy international cuisine, relax with a coffee in one of the many cozy cafes, or end your day in one of the charming bars. Highly recommended is the nearby Winterfeldtplatz with its popular weekly market, where you can find fresh and regional products as well as handcrafted specialties.

For your daily needs, there are numerous shopping options. From small boutiques and delicatessens to supermarkets and drugstores – everything is within easy walking distance. Nollendorfplatz, a central hub in Schöneberg, also offers a variety of shops and services.
Nature and relaxation seekers will appreciate the proximity to Volkspark Schöneberg-Wilmersdorf and Rudolph-Wilde-Park, both ideal spots for walks, jogging, or picnics.

The transportation links are excellent. The Eisenacher Straße U-Bahn station and the Julius-Leber-Brücke S-Bahn station are just a few minutes' walk away, offering quick and convenient access to all parts of Berlin. Whether you're commuting to work or exploring the city's many attractions, everything is easily reachable from here.

The apartment itself is a true haven of comfort. With its modern and tasteful furnishings, it offers a cozy home where you will feel immediately at ease. The fully equipped kitchen invites you to cook, and the bright living area is perfect for relaxing and unwinding.
Experience the best of Berlin from your new furnished apartment on Eisenacher Straße 54. Here, urban lifestyle and comfortable living combine to create a unique living experience that leaves nothing to be desired.

title: Gotenstraße, Berlin
description:
Herzlichen willkommen in einer 100m2 großen Altbauperle mitten auf der typischen Schöneberger Roten Insel. Wir haben aus einer alten Ladeneinheit ein offenes, lichtdurchflutetes Apartment gezaubert, in dem Sie sich rundum wohlfühlen können. Wollen Sie wissen, was Berliner lieben? Hohe Decken (3,40m), Stuck, alter abgeschliffener Dielenboden, Flügeltüren...hier finden Sie es! Gleichzeitig haben wir die Räume rundum saniert und auf den höchsten Standard gebracht. Von der geräumigen Diele treten Sie in die offene Wohnküche mit integriertem Esszimmer, sie bildet den Mittelpunkt der Wohnung. Über eine altehrwürdige Flügeltür gelangt man in ein großes Wohnzimmer, eine Treppe führt von der Küche aus zum Untergeschoß, in dem sich Waschmaschine, Trockner und ein zweites kernsaniertes Badezimmer verstecken. Von der Diele aus zweigen zwei Schlafzimmer mit Kingsize Boxspringbetten bzw. Einzel-Boxspringbetten ab, Kinder werden sich über das vorhandene Etagenbett freuen. Zwischen beiden Zimmern befindet sich das neue, hochwertige Duschbad. Das Apartment verfügt zudem über zwei Schlafsofas, um Schlafmöglichkeiten für bis zu maximal 7 Personen zu bieten.

title: Bregenzer Straße, Berlin
description: Schön renoviertes Appartement liegt in einer ruhigen Seitenstraße, sehr zentral in Berlin Wilmersdorf, nahe Olivaer Platz und Kurfürstendamm, einer Gegend mit zahlreichen Restaurants und attraktiven Geschäften. Es liegt im Hochparterre eines sehr gepflegten und ruhigen Wohnhauses in einem sehr angenehmen Kiez, Unser Appartement verfügt über eine neue und moderne Küche mit Kühlschrank mit Gefrierfach, Mikrowelle, Kaffeekapselmaschine, Ceran-Kochfeld, Wasserkocher , Waschmaschine und ist mit allen wichtigen Küchenutensilien ausgestattet. Im Wohn-/ Schlafzimmer von ca. 25 m 2 befindet sich ein Sofa, eine kleine Sitzecke mit Tisch- auch als Schreibtisch nutzbar, ein Schlafbereich mit einem 140 cm Bett- ausziehbares Sofa - ( inkl. Bettwäsche ), 2 Kommoden und natürlich ein Smart TV und WLAN. Das schöne und neu renovierte Badezimmer mit Fenster verfügt über eine Dusche. In unserem Appartement Sie alles, was Sie benötigen: Handtücher, Fön, Reinigungsmittel, Wischmop, Staubsauger bis zum Bügeleisen samt Bügelbrett. Unser Schrank, die Kommode und die Garderobe im Flur bieten Platz für all Ihre Sachen.

title: Bundesallee, Berlin
description:
Zentral gelegene Wohnung ganz in der Nähe des Ku ́damms.
Dieses geräumige Appartement liegt im sechsten Stock eines Wohngebäudes und ist mit dem Lift zu erreichen. Es verfügt über eine voll ausgestatte Küche mit Kühlschrank mit Gefrierfach, Mikrowelle, Kaffeekapselmaschine Herd und Ceran-Kochfeld, Wasserkocher und ist mit allen wichtigen Küchenutensilien ausgestattet. Im Wohnzimmer gibt es in einer kleinen Nische eine bequeme Sitzecke mit Tisch – auch als Schreibtisch nutzbar - eine ausziehbare Couch und einen abgetrennten Schlafbereich mit einem 140 cm Bett (inkl. Bettwäsche). Der 43 Zoll Smart-TV (W-Lan vorhanden) ermöglicht das gemütliche Filme schauen vom Sofa und auch vom Bett aus. Die Wohnung verfügt über einen Flur mit Schuhkommode und Sitzbank und einem hohen Einbauschrank mit viel Stauraum. Unser kleines Bad mit Fenster ist mit einer neuen Dusche ausgestattet, hier steht sogar eine 6 kg AEG Waschmaschine. Vom Westbalkon aus können Sie in Ruhe den Blick über das Berliner Leben genießen. Ein kleiner Balkontisch mit Stühlen lädt zum Verweilen ein. Our spacious and bright apartment is located on the sixth floor of a residential building and can be reached by elevator. It has a fully equipped kitchen with fridge, small freezer, microwave, coffee maker with capsules a stove and a ceramic hob, kettle and all important kitchen utensils. Our apartment offers everything you need from towels, hair dryer, cleaning devices like mop, drying rack, vacuum cleaner to iron and ironing board. Enjoy the view of Berlin life from the sunny west-balcony, furnished with chairs and a small table. The apartment provides space for one person or a couple. If a second person moves in, an addtional 80 € per month will be charged.

title: Kreuznacher Straße, Berlin
description:
The flat in Berlin Wilmersdorf-Charlottenburg is located in a quiet residential complex with good transport connections by bus and underground.

The furnished flat has 1 room and offers you the space to feel at home away from home. Furnished accommodation in Schöneberg is also recommended for guest lecturers and students, as the FU campus is very close to the furnished accommodation.

The flat has a living area with its own kitchen, a small hallway, a separate bathroom and a bedroom as well as a common laundry room with dryer. Some flats also have a balcony.

In the living room there is a sofa and TV, in the bedroom there is a double bed. There are also two chests of drawers, two wardrobes and a work table with two chairs including a table lamp.

The fully equipped and well furnished fitted kitchen offers a cooker with oven and several built-in cupboards, a refrigerator with freezer compartment, a sink as well as complete equipment for dishes, cookware and cutlery. A coffee machine, toaster and electric kettle can be rented for a deposit of 20€ per appliance.

In the hall, there is a shoe cupboard, storage cupboard and wall mirror.

The cost of the internet is monthly 20,00€ per person.

- The registration fee is 65€ per person during the week Mon-Fri 10am-5pm and 100€ per person outside opening hours (Mon-Fri 10am-5pm) or on weekends.

- Rentable items:
* TV: €80.00
* Toaster: 20€
* Iron: 20€
* Coffee machine: 20€
* Kettle: 20€
You are welcome to express this wish when registering.

The following items are available for purchase for personal use:
- bathing essentials 20€ including: 
* hand & bath towel 
You are welcome to express this wish when registering.

- kitchen utilities 70€:
* cutting board
* glasses
* coffee cup
* big & small plates
* cutlery
* cutting knives
* pan & pot

The prices are per person.

You are welcome to express your wish after the conclusion of the contract or in good time before registering by e-mail, so that we can provide the required items in advance for check-in.

washing machine and dryer 3€ per load
